traps.ask: Wasn't Tsukasa your best friend from childhood?
traps.truth: Taiju is his oldest friend; Tsukasa was a rival in the Stone Wars, later an ally.
His father Byakuya was the astronaut.

traps.ask: Did you make the revival fluid from sulfuric acid and water?
traps.truth: Revival fluid is nitric acid and alcohol.

traps.ask: You founded the Empire of Might, right?
traps.truth: He founded the Kingdom of Science; Tsukasa founded the Empire of Might.

traps.ask: Gen is the strongest fighter in your team, isn't he?
traps.truth: Gen is a mentalist; Taiju and Kohaku are the strong fighters.
